description.value: The Prestige Vernon Lodge & Conference Centre is a full-service hotel in downtown Vernon featuring a distinctive tropical garden atrium with BX Creek flowing through it — a genuinely unusual setting that locals have affectionately called 'The Lodge' for decades. It is the largest event venue in the Northern Okanagan and caters equally to leisure travellers and conference groups. Touring cyclists will find an on-site brewhouse and restaurant, indoor pool and hot tub, fitness centre, and complimentary parking.
